title: auth_me
description: Response body for GET /v1/auth/me — current authenticated session principal info derived from the BrowserSessionPlug-lifted session. Does NOT expose the JWT or any cookie content. Per contracts/audit_api_extensions.md §'Auth introspection' the shape is flat snake_case (the SPA's useAuth hook reads each field directly).

principal_subject.description: Stable principal identifier (e.g., 'alice@corp', 'auth0|...'), straight from the JWT 'sub' / principal.subject claim.

recurse_role.description: Console role the principal carries for this session. Single role per session in F004.

tenant_id.description: ULID identifying the tenant that owns this Browser Session. Single-tenant per deployment in F004.

browser_session_id.description: ULID identifying this specific Browser Session (cookie envelope). Stable across the cookie's 8h absolute lifetime; rotates on a fresh login.

session_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the cookie envelope hits its 8h absolute timeout. After this, BrowserSessionPlug drops the cookie regardless of activity.

session_idle_timeout_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant when the cookie envelope hits its 60-min idle timeout, computed from last_activity_at. Refreshed by mutation-only rotation.
